headline: Adobe brings 70+ tools from Photoshop, Illustrator, and more directly to Slack
summary: Users can now access a comprehensive suite of Adobe's creative and productivity tools, including Firefly, Photoshop, and Premiere, directly within Slack without switching apps.
details: Adobe has launched a new integration with Slack, bringing over 70 tools from its popular creative and productivity apps directly into the communication platform. This includes features from Adobe Firefly, Adobe Express, Photoshop, Premiere, Acrobat, InDesign, Illustrator, Stock, and Lightroom, allowing extensive work to be done without leaving Slack.

This implementation mirrors a recent ChatGPT plugin, also providing access to more than 70 Adobe tools. The Adobe for Slack integration is now available for Slack Business+ and Enterprise+ customers across web, mobile, and desktop versions of Slack.

An Adobe account is not strictly required to use the Slack app, though having one unlocks fuller access to the tools. Once installed, users can message Slackbot with a task, and the chatbot will utilize the most relevant Adobe tools to complete the assignment.

Slackbot can draw on content from within Slack channels and Canvases, as well as from Adobe Creative Cloud assets. Potential uses range from converting spreadsheets into visuals and creating marketing content from templates to executing bulk edits on numerous images.
